Ultimate Gluten-Free Thanksgiving in NYC: Best Eats for 2026

November 9, 2026November 9, 2026 Erin Smith

Find the best gluten-free Thanksgiving dinners in NYC for 2026, from 100% gluten-free restaurants to celiac-friendly menus, catering and pies.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:35
Instaread

Looking for a gluten-free Thanksgiving dinner in New York City? This guide covers restaurants serving holiday menus with turkey and gluten-free sides, plus bakeries taking pre-orders for gluten-free Thanksgiving pies and desserts.

Whether you have celiac disease, live with gluten sensitivity, or simply want a holiday meal without the cooking, you’ll find 100% gluten-free restaurants, spots with dedicated gluten-free menus, and bakeries that offer pickup and catering. Order deadlines are coming up fast, so book your table or place your pie order soon.

Thanksgiving reservations in Manhattan fill up quickly, so book as early as you can, especially for larger parties and prepaid prix fixe dinners.

Note: Menus, prices and kitchen practices are subject to change. Always contact each restaurant directly about ingredients, preparation and cross-contact before you dine.

Additionally, It’s up to you to do your due diligence when eating out with celiac disease or a gluten allergy.

Dedicated Gluten-Free Restaurants Serving Thanksgiving Meals

Senza Gluten by Jemiko

Website
Open from 12 PM on Thanksgiving and serving the full dinner menu and Thanksgiving specials all day! Reservations recommended.

626 10th Avenue
Manhattan, NY 10036

Senza Gluten Restaurant

Thanksgiving Details
Serving the regular dinner menu all day long with Thanksgiving specials such as traditional turkey, stuffing, and gravy. Open Thanksgiving Day 11am-11pm; last reservation 9:15pm. Reservations recommended.

206 Sullivan Street
Manhattan, NY 10012

Non-Dedicated Restaurants with Gluten-Free Thanksgiving Menus

Bistango

Thanksgiving Menu
Includes choice of one starter, one main course, and one dessert. $85 per adult. The children’s menu is half price. Reservations recommended.

145 East 50th Street
Manhattan, NY, 10022

Pappardella

Thanksgiving Menu
Pappardella is serving a gluten-free version of their thanksgiving menu plus à la carte gluten-free options. Reservations recommended.

316 Columbus Avenue,
New York, NY 10023

Friedman’s Restaurants

Thanksgiving Details
All locations except Chelsea & Battery Park are open and serving a Thanksgiving menu with gluten-free options. $54.95 adults and $34.95 kids. Reservations recommended.

Manhattan, NY 100123

Jack’s All Day

Thanksgiving Details
From the owners of Friedman’s, this restaurant is open and serving a Thanksgiving menu with gluten-free options. $54.95 adults and $34.95 kids. Reservations recommended.

731 8th Avenue
Manhattan, NY 10036

Gluten-Free Thanksgiving Catering

Modern Bread and Bagel

Thanksgiving Menu
Organic and Kosher turkey available. Full menu of side dish, vegetables, latkes, desserts and more! Order by November 22 at 11 p.m. ET. November 25th and 26th pick-up available.

Agata & Valentina

Catering Menu
Catering menu includes full Thanksgiving dinners, side dishes, turkeys, and more. All Thanksgiving orders must be placed by noon on Friday, November 20th.

Gluten-Free Thanksgiving Desserts from Dedicated Gluten-Free Bakeries

By the Way Bakery

Thanksgiving Menu
Last day to place your holiday order is Friday, November 20th. Kosher-sealed products available.

3X3 Kitchen

Thanksgiving Menu
Order by November 15 for local pickup. Check website for pickup locations.

Knead Love Bakery

Thanksgiving Menu
Delivery and pickup are available November 17th-November 25th. GrowNYC Greenmarkets pickups available. Check website for locations. Limited spots available for a special Wednesday 11/24 NYC delivery.

Country Road Bakery

Thanksgiving Menu
Backed in the Catskills and totally gluten-free, here is a new option for New Yorkers this Thanksgiving. Pre-orders close on November 19th. Pick up in Washington Square Park on November 25th.

Everybody Eats

Website
Apple Pie ($40) and Pumpkin Pie ($35) available. Contact the bakery directly for ordering details.

Sixteen Mill

Thanksgiving Details
Apple pie is sold out but other pies still available. Pre-order ASAP! Open Tuesday, November 24th and Wednesday, November 25th. Open limited hours on Thanksgiving day 8:30am-1pm.

552 Union Street
Brooklyn, NY

NoGlu

Thanksgiving Menu
Pre-order now before November 21st.

1260 Madison Avenue
Manhattan, NY 10128

PoshPop

Thanksgiving Details

Whether you book a table at a gluten-free restaurant, or do both, gluten-free thanksgiving nyc is easier to plan. Reserve early, place your pie orders before deadlines, and call each restaurant to confirm the menu and cross-contact practices. Menus and policies change year to year.

Have a favorite spot that I missed, or a great experience from this year? Share it in the comments to help other readers. Happy Thanksgiving!

Erin Smith is a passionate advocate for individuals with celiac disease and the founder of Gluten-Free Globetrotter. Diagnosed with celiac disease in 1981, she has spent her life navigating a gluten-free lifestyle and inspiring others to do the same.As a pioneer in the gluten-free community, Erin established the NYC Celiac Meetup group, fostering a strong support network for those living with the condition. Her blog and website, Gluten-Free Globetrotter, have become invaluable resources for travelers seeking gluten-free options around the world.Through her tireless efforts, Erin has transformed the way people with celiac disease approach food and travel.
